jurisdiction.name: Nicaragua
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Nicaragua has no national AI law or strategy. Its AI-related instruments are the 2012 Personal Data Protection Law (Law 787), three 2026 guides from the National Education System on responsible and ethical use of AI by students, teachers and families, and the National Assembly's September 2026 decree approving the China-led World AI Cooperation Organization (WAICO) agreement.
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026 from the National Assembly's legislation portal, the official gazette and the national technological institute's website. A health-sector AI roadmap and an education catalogue of AI tools are tracked as leads.

instruments.official_title: Ley N°. 787, Ley de Protección de Datos Personales
instruments.english_title: Law No. 787, Personal Data Protection Law
instruments.current_status: In force since publication in La Gaceta No. 61 of 29 March 2012 (approved 21 March 2012; art. 56). Implemented by a regulation (Reglamento de la Ley N° 787) and corrected by an erratum, both listed on the Asamblea legislation portal; no AI-specific amendment found. The 2026 National Education System AI guides cite it as part of the legal framework for AI use.
instruments.summary: Nicaragua's general data protection law, protecting natural and legal persons against the processing, automated or not, of their personal data in public and private data files, and guaranteeing privacy and informational self-determination. It requires consent for processing and transfers, gives data subjects rights of information, access, rectification and deletion, obliges data controllers to register their files, and creates the Directorate for Personal Data Protection attached to the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit to supervise processing. It contains no AI-specific or automated-decision provisions but governs personal data used to train and run AI systems.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Personal data protection law; governs personal data processed by AI systems (applies to automated and non-automated processing).
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): full text read on the Asamblea Nacional legislation portal (approval 21 March 2012, La Gaceta No. 61 of 29 March 2012, art. 1 scope, arts. 28-29 Directorate, art. 56 entry into force); La Gaceta No. 61/2012 PDF read with pdftotext (Ley No. 787 listed in the summary at p. 2402).

instruments.official_title: Decreto A.N. N°. 8933, Decreto de Aprobación del “Acuerdo Sobre el Establecimiento de la Organización Mundial para la Cooperación en Inteligencia Artificial”
instruments.english_title: Legislative Decree A.N. No. 8933 approving the Agreement on the Establishment of the World AI Cooperation Organization
instruments.current_status: Approved 29 September 2026 and published in La Gaceta No. 179 of 1 October 2026; the decree is in force from publication (art. 4). The agreement itself enters into force on deposit of the third instrument of ratification (article XV); deposit of Nicaragua's ratification instrument was not confirmed on an official source as of 12 October 2026.
instruments.summary: Legislative decree by which the National Assembly approves the Agreement on the Establishment of the World AI Cooperation Organization (WAICO), signed by Nicaragua in Shanghai on 16 July 2026, and instructs the Presidency to ratify it and deposit the instrument with the Government of the People's Republic of China. The annexed agreement creates an intergovernmental organization whose purposes include promoting AI development and application, expanding international AI cooperation, closing the AI divide and jointly mitigating AI risks to promote safe, reliable and ethical AI. The decree's recitals frame participation as serving technological sovereignty, digital transformation and global governance of emerging technologies.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Nicaragua's national approval of an international AI cooperation and governance treaty.

instruments.official_title: Uso y manejo responsable y ético de la IA para estudiantes
instruments.english_title: Responsible and ethical use and handling of AI for students
instruments.issuing_authority: National Education System (Sistema Educativo Nacional), published by the National Technological Institute (Tecnológico Nacional)
instruments.current_status: Published in TecNacional's virtual library on 19 March 2026 together with companion guides for teachers and for parents; no expiry or revision stated.
instruments.summary: Guide (cartilla) of the National Education System for students at all levels on using AI tools responsibly, critically and ethically in learning and daily life. It sets out the legal framework of the Cybercrime Law (No. 1042) and the Personal Data Protection Law (No. 787), recommendations for use, risks of improper use such as technological dependence, disinformation and exposure of personal data, and advice and examples on writing prompts for virtual assistants. It frames AI adoption under the National Education Strategy 'Bendiciones y Victorias' 2024-2026.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: AI-specific guidance setting expectations for responsible and ethical AI use across the national education system.
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): full PDF read with pdftotext (presentation, introduction, scope, contents); the publication date 19 March 2026 is the 'Fecha de publicación' stated on TecNacional's own document page (https://www.tecnacional.edu.ni/documentos/uso-y-manejo-responsable-y-etico-de-la-ia-para-estudiantes/). instruments.english_title: Responsible and ethical use and handling of AI for teachers
instruments.issuing_authority: National Education System (Sistema Educativo Nacional), published by the National Technological Institute (Tecnológico Nacional)
instruments.current_status: Published in TecNacional's virtual library on 19 March 2026 together with companion guides for students and for parents; no expiry or revision stated.
instruments.summary: Guide (cartilla) of the National Education System for teachers on integrating AI tools into teaching safely and ethically. It covers the legal framework of Laws No. 1042 and No. 787, advice and recommendations for classroom use (assessing a tool's purpose and risks before adoption, not entering students' sensitive information into AI platforms, checking privacy policies, supervising students' use), AI limitations, errors, bias and dependence, and practical case studies.

instruments.english_title: Supporting daughters and sons in the responsible and ethical use and handling of AI

instruments.summary: Guide (cartilla) of the National Education System for mothers, fathers and guardians on accompanying children and young people in safe, responsible and ethical use of AI tools. It sets out the legal framework of Laws No. 1042 and No. 787, the risks of AI for minors, and recommendations for family supervision of AI use, and states that its orientations are to be read as an extension of those laws.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Nicaragua's legislation portal, central government, ministries and regulators were searched in Spanish, and all were reached. No AI law, AI bill, deepfake offence or national AI strategy was found, and there was no AI-specific material for laws, strategies, government AI governance, risk and assurance, public-sector use, procurement, cybersecurity, transparency, standards, sandboxes, indices, drafts or older publications. Whether the ratification of the WAICO agreement has been deposited remains to be checked.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. All units reached. Law 787 has no automated-decision provision; recorded as general data protection law. Decreto A.N. 8933 (WAICO approval) recorded as international_treaty, adopted, in force on publication 2026-10-01 (La Gaceta 179); deposit of ratification unverified. Education guides dated 2026-03-19 from the 'Fecha de publicación' line displayed on TecNacional's own document pages (PDFs undated) - page-stated date, not file metadata; issuer named only as Sistema Educativo Nacional. Ley 1042, Ley 1219, Cybersecurity Strategy 2020-2025: no AI. Ley 1243 (military code) AI in passing (lead). Convention 108: not a party. Units covered: Law: Asamblea Nacional legislation portal (normas jurídicas, incl. La Gaceta copies) searched in Spanish for inteligencia artificial, algoritmo, ultrafalso/deepfake, datos personales, Convenio 108, transformación digital, ciberseguridad. Found: Law No. 787 on personal data protection (recorded) and Legislative Decree A.N. No. 8933 approving the WAICO agreement (recorded). Cybercrime Law No. 1042 (2020) and its reform Law No. 1219 (2024), the National Cybersecurity Strategy 2020-2025 (Decreto Presidencial 24-2020) and the higher-education regulatory compendium (2023) contain no AI provisions. Law No. 1243 (military code reform, 2025) mentions AI only in passing (lead). No AI law, AI bill or deepfake offence found.; Government: Searched, nothing found: no national AI strategy, digital strategy with an AI pillar, national AI body, or public-sector AI/GenAI guideline published by the central government.; Ministries: Education: National Education System AI guides for students, teachers and families (recorded, TecNacional) and AI tools catalogue 2026 (lead); MINED and CNU searched, no separate AI documents found. Health: MINSA AI-in-health roadmap planned only (lead). Defence: AI mentioned in passing in the military code reform (lead). Justice, finance/tax, labour, interior: searched, nothing found.; Regulators: Searched, nothing found: data protection directorate (Ministry of Finance), central bank (BCN), banking supervisor (SIBOIF), telecom regulator (TELCOR) have no AI-specific documents; no national cyber agency AI guidance; no standards adoption, sandbox, procurement rule, algorithm register or AI index.. Not reached: none. Could not verify: Deposit of Nicaragua's WAICO ratification instrument (not found on an official source).; mined.gob.ni site search for inteligencia artificial returned an empty page by curl; no MINED copy of the education AI guides found by web search.. binding-law, strategy, government-governance, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, drafts, historical: no material found.

leads.title: Catálogo de Herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial 2026
leads.issuing_authority: Technology Commission of the National Education System (published by Tecnológico Nacional)
leads.note: Official document on tecnacional.edu.ni (document page states 'Fecha de publicación: 18 de febrero de 2026'); https://tecnacional.edu.ni/media/Catalogo_de_Herramientas_de_Inteligencia_Artificial_2026.pdf. Mostly a catalogue of AI tools by pedagogical use; it has a one-page ethics and safety section (verify outputs, acknowledge AI use, do not use AI to write or interpret results). Held as a lead because its main content is a tool listing rather than governance; could be promoted as education-sector guidance on review.

leads.title: Ley N°. 1243, Ley de Reformas y Adiciones a la Ley N°. 181, Código de Organización, Jurisdicción y Previsión Social Militar
leads.english_title: Law No. 1243 amending Law No. 181, Code of Military Organization, Jurisdiction and Social Security
leads.note: Approved 26 March 2025, La Gaceta No. 60 of 28 March 2025 (http://legislacion.asamblea.gob.ni/normaweb.nsf/9e314815a08d4a6206257265005d21f9/10f6b20238e10b3f06258c5b0072bfa7). Mentions AI only in passing: the Army's functions include airspace/maritime surveillance 'con el empleo de tecnología moderna e inteligencia artificial' and contributing to the use of AI, and the Signals Corps develops ICT 'con el empleo de inteligencia artificial'. No rules on AI; fails the scope test.

leads.title: Hoja de ruta nacional de inteligencia artificial en salud (MINSA)
leads.english_title: National roadmap for AI in health (Ministry of Health)
leads.note: Planned. A MINSA–PAHO/WHO national workshop (reported 17 September 2026) set 24-month priorities for responsible AI in health, including strengthening the regulatory and ethical framework; results are to feed a future national AI-in-health roadmap and governance mechanisms. No official MINSA document found online. Record once published.
